_comment: Label taxonomy on three axes (type, area/*, status/*). Source of truth for scripts/sync_labels.sh. area/* names mirror terraform-microsoft365-entra (the sibling reusable-module repo) for cross-repo consistency; type/status/legacy-default labels mirror what is already live here and on infrastructure-core (IAC-BL-24).

labels.name: feature
labels.description: New feature or capability (commit type: feat)

labels.name: status/blocked
labels.description: Blocked on an external dependency or a gate

labels.name: status/needs-human
labels.description: Needs a human decision (filed by a person)

labels.name: dependencies
labels.description: Pull requests that update a dependency file

labels.name: github_actions
labels.description: Pull requests that update GitHub Actions code

labels.name: duplicate
labels.description: This issue or pull request already exists

labels.name: wontfix
labels.description: This will not be worked on
